entities.summary: Clan Ogilvy, also known as Clan Ogilvie, is a Scottish family from Angus, Scotland. Gillebride, Earl of Angus, received a barony from King William the Lion in 1163 and bestowed the lands of Ogilvy upon his son Gilbert. In 1429, Sir Patrick Ogilvy, who was later styled as Viscomte d'Angus, commanded the Scottish forces that fought alongside Saint Joan of Arc against the English, and Saint Joan of Arc marched into Orléans to the sound of bagpipes, accompanied by a guard of around 60 Scottish men-at-arms, and 70 archers.
